outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with Iran live updates: After launching strikes, US warns of escalation if Iran responds; LIVE: ABC News Live; Bank of America worker killed in 'unprovoked' Times Square stabbing identified.

items.headline: Iran live updates: After launching strikes, US warns of escalation if Iran responds
items.detail: The Strait of Hormuz remains the primary flashpoint in the conflict.

items.headline: LIVE: ABC News Live
items.detail: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

items.headline: Bank of America worker killed in 'unprovoked' Times Square stabbing identified
items.detail: The stabbings occurred at 42nd Street and Seventh Avenue. The woman allegedly fled north toward the NYPD substation, where police confronted her, authorities said.

items.headline: Beloved dad of 4 who was killed by lightning stopped to help boater, cousin says
items.detail: A beloved father of four died from a lightning strike while jet-skiing in Florida, according to officials and his family.

items.headline: WATCH: Julianne Hough and Alfonso Ribeiro tease 'DWTS' Season 35
items.detail: Co-hosts Julianne Hough and Alfonso Ribeiro preview "Dancing With the Stars" season 35, teasing the new cast set to be revealed Wednesday on Good Morning America.
